card.name: Words just before drainage or surgery terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas right before a procedure word such as surgery, draining, or a catheter or syringe term. Also seen in lists of alternative names for a procedure.

modes.label: Link word before procedure
modes.description: A preposition or verb such as 'to', 'by' or 'be' just before surgery or draining.
modes.example: administered once, intravenously, 30 to 60 minutes prior<< to>> surgery.

modes.label: Comma in a list of names
modes.description: A comma inside a list of alternative names or a series of roles or terms.
modes.example: Outpatient surgery may also be called same-day surgery, in-and-out surgery<<,>> and ambulatory surgery.

modes.label: Catheter or syringe description
modes.description: Part of a compound word describing a catheter-tipped syringe.
modes.example: empty the granules into a 60 mL catheter-t<<ipped>> syringe.
